_doc: Canonical position-bias click model for L1 'The Lost Record' (catch-goodhart beat). Single source for the pos-bias-curve widget AND the facts-gate (γ, top-1 %, top-3 %). ILLUSTRATIVE — modelled, not from a proprietary click log.
model: position-based examination model — the 'examination hypothesis' studied in Craswell, Zoeter, Taylor, Ramsey 2008 (NOT their cascade model: examination here depends on rank only, never on the ranks above): CTR = examination × relevance; all relevance EQUAL → clicks are pure position bias. examination ∝ 1/rank^γ, γ fit so rank-1 ≈ 32% (Enquiro 2005 'golden triangle'). 'Clicks reveal relative not absolute relevance' = Joachims, Granka et al. 2005.
label: ILLUSTRATIVE — modelled, not from a proprietary click log.
